adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (Structured theory-of-mind state linking percepts, beliefs, desires, and actions) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment.
